about: CLASSIC head reference (Kit.Scalp of a look.headShape "classic": AnatomyHairKit.CLASSIC rounded cylinder), NOMINAL head space (1.2-stud head; real = nominal * k), +X right, +Y up, -Z forward, origin = Head part centre

body.about: Kit.Scalp body proxy (nominal head space): S.body = smin(smin(capsule neck, ellipsoid trapezius, 0.2), roundbox torso, 0.12); surface.rows = {y, r per azimuth (deg, 0 = +Z back, 90 = +X)} distance from the axis x = z = 0 to S.body's zero set

fades.about: Kit.FADES with the classic head's side lift (Kit.CLASSIC_HAIR.fadeSide) and AnatomyHair FADE_TOP + the same lift. topLines: the side/back top line {da, x, y, z}. coverage[kind][i][j]: Kit.Cut coverage at the radial grid's surface points (0 skin .. 1 hair; natural hairline, density 1)

hairline.about: Kit.Hairline(S, kind, growth 0) on the classic head (Kit.ClassicKeys): per line, right / left = {da, x, y, z} surface points (da = angle from the front centre around the vertical axis x = 0, z = 0.05; right = +X); height = {da, nominal y of the line}. false = no crossing found

radial.about: r[i][j]: distance from centre to the head surface along dir = (sin th sin az, cos th, sin th cos az); th = thetas[i] deg from +Y, az = azimuths[j] deg, 0 = +Z (back), 90 = +X (right), 180 = -Z (front)

rig.about: the default rig (tools/sim/host.luau Host.RIG): real studs; head space positions also nominal
